name: UI UX Pro Max
summary: Agent skill that generates a tailored design system — styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules — before UI code is written.
description: An AI skill that reasons about your product type to generate design guidance: 79 searchable UI styles (50 active), 192 industry-specific color palettes, 74 curated font pairings, 25 chart types for dashboards, 119 UX guidelines and anti-patterns, and 192 industry reasoning rules, matched through a BM25 search engine. It ships as a CLI that installs per-agent files for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex and more, with stack-specific guidance for 22 frameworks; a design system can be persisted to files for hierarchical retrieval.
contains: 192 industry color palettes aligned to 192 product types
74 font pairings, 25 chart types, 119 UX guidelines
BM25 search over the style, palette and font catalog
basic version free; premium adds brand identity and asset generation
